Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MSFT.
Our cloud segment grew 19% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 19% to 16% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2020.
We delivered record revenue of $24.0 billion this quarter, representing 19% year-over-year growth.
Revenue guidance of $24.0 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. We generated $3.5 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
